meta.title: Echoes of the 100th Floor
meta.laneRule: Global secret callings are checked first. Otherwise the two highest stats select a lane (PURE_<STAT> when top >= 6 and second <= 2, else the canonical pair). Within a lane, classes are checked by descending priority; the final class in each lane is an unconditional catch-all.
meta.tieBreak: Ties are broken by canonical stat order: STR > DEX > INT > VIT > WIS > LUK.

classes.name: The Equilibrium
classes.epithet: Six hungers, one perfect stillness.
classes.passive: Perfect Balance: the first skill you use each combat costs 0 AP.

classes.name: The Gambler
classes.epithet: Luck is not a stat. It is a debt.
classes.passive: House Edge: critical hits refund 1 AP; critical misses deal 1 damage to self.

classes.name: The Berserker
classes.epithet: Eight parts fury. Two parts meat. No defense.
classes.passive: No Defense: cannot equip armor or shields. Gains +1 AP while below 50% HP.

classes.name: The Oathbreaker
classes.epithet: Three vows, broken in perfect measure.
classes.passive: Broken Word: enemies adjacent to you lose 10% of their magic resistance.

classes.name: The Ascetic
classes.epithet: No body to wound. No fortune to steal.
classes.passive: Empty Vessel: immune to Bleed and Poison. Max HP is halved, but evasion is doubled.

classes.name: The Blind Prophet
classes.epithet: The dungeon shows them everything. That is the problem.
classes.passive: Unseen Sight: all traps and secret doors on the floor are revealed on entry.

classes.name: The Heretic
classes.epithet: Faith is a resource. He spends it.
classes.passive: Profane Fuel: spells may be paid with HP instead of MP at 2 HP per 1 MP.

classes.name: The Martyr
classes.epithet: The body is the only offering the dungeon accepts.
classes.passive: Offering: when you die, your Echo spawns with -20% HP and grants double Memory Shards.

classes.name: The Thing That Waits
classes.epithet: It has been on the 100th floor longer than the floor has existed.
classes.passive: Patience: at the start of your third consecutive turn in combat, gain +2 AP.

classes.name: The Singularity
classes.epithet: One number. Ten points. No remainder.
classes.passive: Absolute: +25% to your highest stat's derived effects; all other stats count as 0 for requirements.

classes.name: The Muscle Wizard
classes.epithet: Arcane theory, physical delivery.
classes.passive: Fist of the Fifth Circle: unarmed strikes scale with STR and ignore 20% of DEF.

classes.name: The Colossus
classes.epithet: Strength, with just enough sense to keep swinging.
classes.passive: Unstoppable: overkill damage carries to the next enemy in an adjacent tile.

classes.name: The Ghost
classes.epithet: Armor is a confession that you intend to be hit.
classes.passive: Untouchable: +15% evasion while wearing no armor.

classes.name: The Duelist
classes.epithet: One blade. One opening. One hundred floors.
classes.passive: Riposte: the first melee attack that misses you each turn is countered for 50% damage.

classes.name: The Glass Cannon
classes.epithet: One perfect spell. One fatal mistake.
classes.passive: Fragile Genius: +30% spell damage, -30% max HP.

classes.name: The Archivist
classes.epithet: Every floor is a page. She is cataloguing them all.
classes.passive: Marginalia: status effects you apply last one extra turn.

classes.name: The Wall
classes.epithet: Some doors are made of people.
classes.passive: Immovable: cannot be pushed, pulled, or knocked back.

classes.name: The Hearth
classes.epithet: A fire that does not go out, no matter how deep the dark.
classes.passive: Warmth: regenerate 3% max HP at the start of each turn; adjacent summons regenerate 3% as well.

classes.name: The Anchor
classes.epithet: Some heroes hold the line. He is the line.
classes.passive: Ballast: cannot be moved. You and adjacent summons gain +15% physical resistance.

classes.name: The Oracle
classes.epithet: She has already seen the floor. She is not impressed.
classes.passive: Prescience: once per floor, reroll a failed trap check or a lethal hit.

classes.name: The Fool
classes.epithet: The dungeon has killed wiser heroes than you. That is the joke.
classes.passive: Fortune's Fool: 25% chance to completely negate any damage instance.

classes.name: The Monk
classes.epithet: The body is a weapon. The mind is the sheath.
classes.passive: Flowing Form: moving 2+ tiles before an attack grants +1 AP next turn.

classes.name: The Buccaneer
classes.epithet: Fast hands, faster exit.
classes.passive: Sea Legs: no movement penalty on hazard tiles; disengage costs 0 AP once per turn.

classes.name: The Paladin
classes.epithet: Strength above intellect. Intellect above faith. Faith above all.
classes.passive: Aegis: you and adjacent summons take 10% less damage.

classes.name: The Hexblade
classes.epithet: The sword is cursed. So is the hand.
classes.passive: Hex: enemies you hit take +15% damage from all sources until your next turn.

classes.name: The Crusader
classes.epithet: The body is a ram. The faith is the fuse.
classes.passive: Zeal: below 50% HP, gain +20% damage and +10% damage reduction.

classes.name: The Bruiser
classes.epithet: The plan is to still be standing.
classes.passive: Second Wind: the first time you drop below 30% HP each combat, heal 15% max HP.

classes.name: The Juggernaut
classes.epithet: Momentum is a form of armor.
classes.passive: Momentum: each tile moved in a straight line adds +5% damage to your next attack (max +30%).

classes.name: The Warpriest
classes.epithet: The sermon is short. The hammer is long.
classes.passive: Litany: healing also grants the target +10% damage for one turn.

classes.name: The Reaver
classes.epithet: Luck is what you take from the corpse.
classes.passive: Bloodlust: killing an enemy restores 2 AP and 5% max HP.

classes.name: The Corsair
classes.epithet: The dungeon owes her money. She intends to collect.
classes.passive: Plunder: +20% gold and a 10% chance to steal an enemy's equipped item on kill.

classes.name: The Spellblade
classes.epithet: Six parts theory. Four parts violence.
classes.passive: Enchanted Edge: basic attacks deal +25% of your magic damage as elemental damage.

classes.name: The Spellthief
classes.epithet: Your magic. Her hands. No receipt.
classes.passive: Siphon: damaging an enemy with a spell steals 2 MP from them.

classes.name: The Nightblade
classes.epithet: She learned magic to become harder to see.
classes.passive: Umbral Step: teleport up to 3 tiles once per combat; next attack is a guaranteed critical.

classes.name: The Bulwark
classes.epithet: The safest place on the floor is behind him. Usually.
classes.passive: Shield Wall: block chance +25% when you did not move last turn.

classes.name: The Skirmisher
classes.epithet: Hold the line? She would rather move it.
classes.passive: Harrier: +1 AP on any turn in which you both move and attack.

classes.name: The Ironclad
classes.epithet: Plate, patience, and a very large hammer.
classes.passive: Iron Skin: physical damage taken is reduced by 2 flat per hit.

classes.name: The Ranger
classes.epithet: Every floor has a trail. Most of them end badly.
classes.passive: Trailcraft: reveal adjacent rooms on entry and gain +1 tile attack range.

classes.name: The Stalker
classes.epithet: The dungeon is loud. She is not.
classes.passive: Hunter's Patience: attacks from fog of war or flanking deal +20% damage.

classes.name: The Trickster
classes.epithet: The trap was never for you. It was for the thing behind you.
classes.passive: Misdirection: the first attack each combat targets the nearest enemy instead of you.

classes.name: The Necrophage
classes.epithet: The dungeon keeps its dead. He keeps them closer.
classes.passive: Carrion Feast: killing an enemy heals 10% max HP and restores 1 MP.

classes.name: The Warlock
classes.epithet: The patron asked for a body. He brought his own.
classes.passive: Pact: spell damage heals you for 15% of the damage dealt.

classes.name: The Theurge
classes.epithet: Two heavens, one argument.
classes.passive: Confluence: spells cost 1 less MP for each summon on the field (max 2); with no summon, gain +1 MP at the start of each turn.

classes.name: The Inquisitor
classes.epithet: Faith first. Questions later. Answers never.
classes.passive: Inquisition: enemies you damage lose 2 MP and cannot heal for one turn.

classes.name: The Wild Mage
classes.epithet: The spell works. The question is how.
classes.passive: Wild Surge: every spell has a 20% chance to cost 0 MP and deal +50% damage.

classes.name: The Shaman
classes.epithet: The spirits are not guests. They are tenants. She collects rent.
classes.passive: Totem: summon a 1 HP totem once per combat that taunts enemies for 2 turns.

classes.name: The Templar
classes.epithet: A shield is a prayer with edges.
classes.passive: Bulwark: you take 10% less damage. 20% of damage taken by adjacent summons is redirected to you.

classes.name: The Sentinel
classes.epithet: She does not guard the door. She is the door.
classes.passive: Ward: you and summons within 2 tiles gain +20% magic resistance.

classes.name: The Gravewarden
classes.epithet: Someone has to count the dead. Someone has to feed them.
classes.passive: Grave Tithe: each Echo you defeat grants +10% max HP for the rest of the run.

classes.name: The Pilgrim
classes.epithet: Faith is a lantern you carry into places that hate light.
classes.passive: Wayfarer: shrines and healing fountains restore 50% more.
